text: Zalesak型の切り欠き円盤：剛体回転と幾何学的セル平均 Zalesak-type slotted disk: rigid rotation and geometric cell means Zalesak型の切り欠き円盤：剛体回転と幾何学的セル平均 q(x,t)=1_D(c+R(-t)(x-c)); qbar_K(t)=area(K intersect [c+R(t)(D-c)])/area(K), c=(0.5,0.5), T=2*pi. D=disk((0.5,0.75),0.15) minus {0.475<x<0.525,y<0.85}. 単位正方形の2次元スカラー輸送です。速度(.5−y,x−.5)、角速度1、周期2π、中心(.5,.75)・半径.15の円盤から.475<x<.525かつy<.85のスロットを除き、内部1・外部0とします。公式Firedrake例の正規化した切り欠き円盤だけを取り出した変種で、bell・cone・背景値1・DG・流入境界は再現しません。周期有限体積の対向面では法線速度が一致します。連続解の台は境界から離れており、数値的な裾は別に測ります。参照は剛体回転の逆特性と円盤・多角形の解析的な面積積分によるセル平均で、点値を並べた画像や別PDE計算の細格子解ではありません。一回転後の連続形状への帰還と、位置・初期角度を変えた固定診断を区別します。 Zalesak-type slotted disk: rigid rotation and geometric cell means q(x,t)=1_D(c+R(-t)(x-c)); qbar_K(t)=area(K intersect [c+R(t)(D-c)])/area(K), c=(0.5,0.5), T=2*pi. D=disk((0.5,0.75),0.15) minus {0.475<x<0.525,y<0.85}. Unit-square two-dimensional scalar transport with prescribed velocity (0.5-y,x-0.5), angular speed 1 and period2*pi. The baseline indicator is one inside the disk of radius 0.15 centered at (0.5,0.75), excluding 0.475<x<0.525 and y<0.85, and zero outside. This isolates the normalized slotted-cylinder component described in the official Firedrake setup; its bell, cone, background 1, DG discretization and inflow boundary are not copied. Periodic finite-volume normal velocities match on opposite faces; the compact exact body stays away from the boundary, while numerical tails are measured. Exact rigid characteristics and analytic disk/polygon intersection areas define the reference cell means, not rasterized point samples or a second numerical PDE solution. A full turn returns to the initial continuum shape; rotated/shifted variants are separate fixed diagnostics. zalesak-rotation Zalesak型の切り欠き円盤：剛体回転と幾何学的セル平均 Zalesak-type slotted disk: rigid rotation and geometric cell means 厳密解・参照解 参照解 reference solution 解析解 Analytic reference
